sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Endowment Management for Philanthropic and Scientific Grants

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law statutory framework modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law and New York Business Corporation Law, incorporating customary law elements and substantive U.S. legal influence under the Compact of Free Association)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the United States and the Republic of the Marshall Islands (1986, as amended 2003)
Agreement between the Government of the United States of America and the Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands with respect to Taxes on Income (signed 2004, entered into force 2005)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus), signed 2017, in force 2020

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2018 (as amended), together with the AMLCFT Regulations 2019 and directives of the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU); Business Corporations Act 1990, Title 23 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (as amended), governing non-resident business corporations; Registered Agents Act 1991 (as amended), imposing gatekeeping and record-keeping obligations on licensed registered agents; Income Tax Act (applicable only to domestic-source income, with exemption for non-resident corporations).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport for each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin or issuing state
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — the Republic of the Marshall Islands is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; the document must bear a notarization, a certificate of authentication issued by the competent ministry of the originating country, and, where available, countersignature by the Marshall Islands consular or diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the preceding three months) for each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed financial institution in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — same authentication chain as the passport copy, including notarization and competent authority authentication

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent legal existence certificate for any corporate shareholder or director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the applicant's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — certificate must be recent, authenticated by the originating registry, and legalized through the applicable consular channel

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming professional relationship and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corresponding, introducing, or relationship financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — bank letter must be signed by an authorized officer, notarized, and authenticated through the applicable consular chain

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: The licensed registered agent must conduct mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all directors, shareholders, officers, and ultimate beneficial owners against the RMI FIU domestic sanctions list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the United Kingdom Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation list. Any positive match requires immediate escalation to the RMI FIU and refusal of incorporation absent official de-listing or written authorization. Politically Exposed Persons, family members, and close associates must undergo enhanced due diligence, including documentary source of wealth and source of funds verification, senior management approval, and enhanced ongoing transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Registrar of Corporations — Online Corporate Registry System (maintained by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro; filings are submitted through licensed registered agents holding credentials under the Registered Agents Act 1991)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be stated in the English language using the Latin alphabet (letters A through Z, numerals 0 through 9, and limited standard punctuation). No Marshallese script or transliteration is required. A foreign-language name may be adopted only if accompanied by a Latin-alphabet translation that is reserved as the primary statutory corporate name, and the name must be readily distinguishable from all names appearing in the corporate registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed name, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within fourteen (14) calendar days of the rejection notice, presenting evidence of distinctiveness, prior user consent, or ministerial approvals obtained for sensitive tokens. If the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may petition the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands for judicial review under the Civil Procedure Rules. The applicant may concurrently submit a revised name reservation without prejudice to the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Fully permissible. The non-resident Business Corporation is statutorily required only to maintain a registered office at the premises of its licensed registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands. No physical operational office, local employees, or in-country telephone line is required for a charitable endowment entity. The registered agent's address constitutes the statutory domicile for service of process, regulatory correspondence, and inspection, and the register of directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners must be maintained at or accessible electronically from that office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of less than five percent (5%) per annum for a non-resident charitable endowment entity. Unannounced physical inspections under the AMLCFT Act 2018 are directed primarily at licensed registered agents and financial institutions rather than at the offshore principals of non-resident corporations. Direct ministerial inspection of the entity's overseas operational premises is not contemplated by the Business Corporations Act 1990 or the Registered Agents Act 1991.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate name clearance and reservation statutory fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporations Act 1990 Schedule of Fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation filing fee — Non-Resident Business Corporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporations Act 1990 Schedule of Fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year non-resident annual government franchise fee (prepaid)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Bureau of Revenue / Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for annual exemption of non-resident entities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent service for the first year (registered office, registered agent, UBO register maintenance, and statutory compliance file)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent under the Registered Agents Act 1991
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for licensed agent services in the Marshall Islands offshore sector

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT pre-incorporation due diligence package (UBO identification, PEP screening, OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening, risk assessment, and source-of-funds verification)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for institutional-grade AML/CFT onboarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of incorporator, director, and UBO document bundle (passport copies, proof of address, bank references)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and consular authorities in the document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark and applicable consular statutory tariffs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Expedited registration processing and courier delivery of the legalized corporate kit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent and international courier service provider

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (MCA), as amended, Sections 14 through 21, 29, and 44
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1) filed under Section 14 of the MCA
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account requirement for non-resident business corporations under the MCA
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accept the subscription for 1,000 shares of no par value common stock from the founding subscriber, and that the Secretary issue the shares upon payment of par value. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation be located at Trust Company Complex, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and that the registered agent be the authorized corporate services provider. RESOLVED, that the President, Treasurer, and Secretary be appointed as the first officers, each to serve until successors are elected, with full authority to open bank accounts, execute grant agreements, and administer endowment funds consistent with the Corporation’s charitable purposes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register with Marshall Islands Tax Administration and Secure Exempt Status
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands Tax Administration (MITA) and Ministry of Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and file the entity classification election confirming non-resident, tax-exempt charitable endowment status. Provide by-laws, proof of incorporation, and a declaration of charitable purpose. If eligible under the IRC as modified, obtain a certificate of tax exemption.
required_dossiers: Board resolution authorizing tax exemption application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If exemption is denied, file an administrative appeal with the Minister of Finance within 30 days and supplement the record with supporting charitable grant documentation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Trade, Commerce, and Investment, Business Licensing Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Operating License for Endowment Management and Philanthropic Grant Distribution

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Agency of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt Category C – office-based, non-industrial activity with negligible environmental impact
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source wastewater discharge; office waste must comply with Majuro municipal solid waste ordinances; no VOC or hazardous air emissions generated in the normal course of endowment administration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the Majuro Fire Department, structural occupancy clearance from the Department of Public Works, and a workplace safety declaration under the Occupational Health and Safety Act of the RMI.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Customs Service (RCS) – Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; official portal: https://www.rmi.gov.mh/tax
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign applicants form the entity through a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent by filing Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations. Upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, the Registrar transmits the name and registered-office details to RCS, which assigns a single Marshall Islands Taxpayer Identification Number (MTIN). No separate VAT ID exists; the MTIN is the only fiscal identifier and is also used for customs and any local business license if onshore activities are commenced.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone – non-resident domestic Business Corporation (BC) is exempt from Marshall Islands national income tax, withholding tax, and gross receipts tax on all non-Marshall Islands source income; a charitable endowment organized as a non-resident BC may also qualify as a tax-exempt private foundation under the Business Corporations Act and the Charitable Organizations Act.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The BC may irrevocably elect 'non-resident status' in its Charter/Articles of Incorporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. RMI law does not provide a U.S.-style check-the-box election; hybrid mismatch elections are not available, and any entity claiming an exemption must file a Notice of Tax-Exempt Status with RCS on formation or within 30 days of commencement.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None – the Marshall Islands does not operate a VAT, GST, or general sales/use tax; limited customs import duty, environmental cess, and municipal business license fees are collected instead.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – no VAT/GST registration threshold. A municipal Business License Tax threshold applies only to a resident entity physically operating a business in Majuro or Ebeye; non-resident offshore corporations are below any local business license nexus.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None – the Marshall Islands has no national e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API posting, or digital stamping mandate. Customs entries are filed electronically through standard customs manifest procedures, but no revenue authority clearance is required for offshore non-resident transactions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable – because RMI has no VAT/GST, exports are outside the scope of indirect tax and zero-rating does not exist. For customs duty relief, a charitable endowment must show that the exported goods are genuine humanitarian supplies, grant-funded equipment, or scientific instruments intended for a Marshall Islands charitable grantee and covered by an RCS non-profit customs exemption certificate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Inward Remittance Certificate (bank SWIFT evidence showing grant funds received)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Since no VAT refund is available, fraudulent export zero-rating cannot be invoked. Any false claim for customs duty exemption is treated as smuggling/deception under the Customs Act and is subject to goods forfeiture, a penalty of not less than 100% and up to 300% of the duty evaded, retrospective revocation of the exemption certificate, clawback of all duties plus interest for the preceding five tax years, and, for directors, a separate fine up to USD 10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands. The RMI maintains no autonomous central bank and issues no national currency; the U.S. Federal Reserve System operates as the de facto monetary authority because the U.S. Dollar is the sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association (1986, amended 2003).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full and unrestricted convertibility in both current and capital accounts. The RMI imposes no exchange-control law, no capital-account authorization regime, and no profit-remittance restriction; since USD is domestic legal tender, inward endowment injections, grant outflows, investment income, and liquidation distributions are freely remittable. A Non-Resident Business Corporation is income-tax-exempt under the Business Corporations Act 1990, so no withholding taxes, no branch-profit remittance charge, and no stamp duty attach to foundation distributions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The RMI has no statutory export-proceeds surrender rule, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation deadline. Proceeds from commodity exports, licensed tuna-fleet landings, and copra sales may be retained in full and in any currency, although USD is the functional banking currency and domestic accounts are denominated in USD.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Republic of the Marshall Islands Branch

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (development lender; not a commercial deposit-taker for non-resident corporates)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW-MEDIUM. Mainstream borderless EMIs (Wise Business, Payoneer, Airwallex) generally decline Marshall Islands legal persons in their jurisdiction matrices; specialist fintech and private-bank EMIs may accept the entity if all UBOs are G7/Asia-Pacific residents and full source-of-funds disclosure is provided. Legal constraint: an offshore EMI servicing the foundation from outside the RMI requires no RMI banking license so long as it does not establish a local branch, but the EMI's correspondent bank may classify RMI corporate flow as higher-risk and impose enhanced screening, account usage caps, or onboarding rejection.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: RMI domestic banks require physical on-island presence: at least one director or authorized signatory, or the licensed RMI registered agent acting as corporate officer, must appear for a face-to-face interview at the Majuro branch; fully remote account opening is not permitted for non-resident business corporations at BMI or Bank of Guam RMI. Offshore correspondent banks and EMIs permit remote onboarding with video-KYC, notarized certified corporate documents, banker's references, and enhanced due-diligence review of 7-15 business days; private-bank relationships in Singapore, Hong Kong, or Zurich may additionally require an in-person board-level meeting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore tax-exempt non-resident corporation flagged as potential shell entity with no economic substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation; Certificate of Good Standing; current annual franchise-tax payment receipt; non-resident status declaration from the RMI Registrar; tax-exemption confirmation; board resolution authorizing account opening; RMI legal opinion on valid existence, non-resident character, and no local tax exposure; beneficial ownership chart; passport copies and proof of address of all directors and UBOs; CRS/FATCA self-certification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Charitable foundation designated as a non-profit organization posing FATF Recommendation 8 terrorist-financing risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Chartered charitable objects clause and endowment trust deed; board-approved grant-making policy; grant-approval minutes; institutional due-diligence file on each grantee (registration certificate, purpose, sanctions-screening result); source-of-funds and source-of-wealth report on the original endower; signed anti-terrorist-financing undertaking; OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening certificate covering the foundation, directors, and grantees.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer-share history or unduly complex ownership chain triggering beneficial-ownership opacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI Beneficial Ownership Act 2016 compliance extract showing the declared UBO registered with the licensed registered agent; current share register and transfer ledger; shareholder resolutions confirming ownership; trust deed, trustee register, and trustee resolutions where the BC is trust-owned; ongoing undertaking to update UBO disclosures within 30 days of any change.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction overlay: RMI long-standing offshore financial center history and prior EU grey-listing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence of RMI's current FATF/APG cooperative status and EU Annex II (grey-list) remediation commitments; economic-substance narrative (exempt for non-resident BC) supplemented by actual investment-management and grant-advisory agreements; audited financial statements; UBO residence in high-tax jurisdictions; bank reference letters from the endower's home bank; transaction-flow diagram for the endowment and grant disbursement lifecycle.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound endowment and donation flows are remitted by SWIFT MT103 in USD, with no RMI exchange-control approval required. Recommended purpose codes: 'GDIR' (Gift/Donation) for philanthropic capital and '8510 Transfers to Non-Profit/NGO' or the receiving bank's internal donation code for subsequent grants. The receiving bank requires the donation or endowment agreement, the board resolution accepting the contribution, the foundation's charitable-purpose charter, and the remitter's KYC pack. USD clearing is executed via Fedwire or CHIPS through the RMI bank's U.S. correspondent; high-value injections (above USD 250,000) should be pre-notified to the AML compliance team and segmented by source to prevent 30-day holds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Grant disbursements and program-related investments use SWIFT MT103 direct credits to beneficiary bank accounts. Where grants finance procurement of goods or services, a documentary collection or Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700) may be opened through an RMI, U.S., or Asian issuing bank. USD-denominated grants require no FX conversion; non-USD grants follow a daily spot FX trade and MT103 in the destination currency. Distributions above USD 100,000 must match the pre-cleared grantee due-diligence file, and each disbursement must be traceable to the foundation's audited financial statements and annual grant report.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forwards – USD/EUR, USD/GBP, USD/JPY, USD/AUD and other major pairs, permitted for hedging non-USD endowment assets or non-USD grant commitments; tenors up to 12 months under an ISDA 1998 FX or master forward agreement with the relationship bank.

Cross-Currency Swaps – USD versus major convertible currencies, permitted for duration-matched hedging of endowment principal and grant liabilities; requires an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement and CSA credit support documentation.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) – USD/CNH, USD/INR, USD/IDR, USD/NGN and other restricted-convertibility currencies, permitted for emerging-market grant programs where onshore deliverable liquidity is unavailable; settled in USD at fixing rates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Report (Annual Return and Franchise Tax Calculation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce and Investment, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: no later than the last day of the month immediately following the calendar month of the original incorporation anniversary; a March 5 incorporation would therefore be due by April 30.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of USD 100 per month or part of a month; continued default for 3 months after written notice may result in administrative dissolution and strike-off by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax Payment for Non-Resident Domestic Corporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations / RMI Ministry of Finance, Revenue Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due concurrently with the Annual Corporation Report; no installment or extension mechanism is available.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid franchise tax accrues interest at 10% per annum; continued non-payment for 60 days triggers issuance of a certificate of revocation of corporate status, after which reinstatement requires a USD 500 penalty in addition to all arrears.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations (RMI Beneficial Ownership Central Database)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: due within 60 days after the anniversary of incorporation, aligned with the Annual Report filing window.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or incomplete confirmation is punishable by a fine of up to USD 10,000 and imprisonment for up to 6 months; repeated failure to confirm beneficial ownership information may lead to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Continuation Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuation is effective upon filing of the Annual Corporation Report; any change of resident agent or registered office must be filed with the Registrar within 15 days after the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered agent and registered office in the Marshall Islands for more than 30 days permits the Registrar to revoke the certificate of registration and dissolve the corporation after notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandatory for a wholly non-resident private business corporation unless it is listed on a recognised stock exchange, holds a licence under the RMI Banking Act or Insurance Act, or is designated as a public-interest entity by RMI regulation. A private charitable foundation may additionally be required to file audited financial statements if imposed by a donor agreement or by the Registrar as a condition of maintaining tax-exempt charitable status.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as the primary financial reporting framework; US GAAP is accepted for non-issuer domestic entities. There is no separately promulgated local GAAP in the Marshall Islands.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: RMI law requires a confidential beneficial ownership central database. The company must file an annual confirmation with the Registrar, stating that the beneficial ownership information in its records is accurate and current. Any transfer of 25% or more of the share capital, or any change in ultimate control, must be reported to the registered agent within 14 days and given formal effect at the next annual confirmation. The confirmation must be renewed annually even where no ownership change has occurred.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - USD 1,500 per year for a standard non-resident business corporation with a resident agent and registered office
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - USD 10,000 for a certified audit prepared in accordance with IFRS by an international-affiliated accounting firm; lower for a review engagement where permitted

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 3% (Income Tax Act 1971, as amended) on RMI-source income of corporations carrying on business within the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Not applicable to this entity: as a Non-Resident Business Corporation holding a valid Non-Resident Certificate, the foundation is statutorily exempt from all Marshall Islands taxes and has no RMI-source income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective rate: 0%. The Marshall Islands imposes no corporate income tax on non-resident entities, no capital gains tax, no net wealth tax, no gift or inheritance tax, no branch remittance tax, and no value-added or sales tax. The only recurrent fiscal costs are the annual BCA government fee (fee bands from US$200 for authorized capital up to 5,000 shares through approximately US$1,000 for larger capital structures) and the registered agent service fee. A charitable endowment foundation engaged exclusively in endowment management and philanthropic grant-making therefore operates under a persistent statutory zero-rate regime.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: BCA Annual Report — Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act 1990, Section 106; filed through the RMI Registrar of Corporations online e-Registry portal (operator: registry.rmi portal managed by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations) or via the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before 30 June of each calendar year, covering corporate particulars as at the preceding 31 December. The first annual report is due in the calendar year following incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Corporate Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name and registration number appearing on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact registered name; a change of name requires prior Articles of Amendment and cannot be effected through the annual report.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 — Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent and the registered office address in the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident BC must continuously maintain a licensed RMI registered agent; any agent change must be endorsed by the incoming agent before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 — Authorized Capital and Share Count
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total number of authorized shares, par value per share (par value zero is permitted), and the number of shares issued.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The annual government fee is computed on the authorized capital band; keeping authorized shares at or below 10,000 minimizes the annual fee. Issued share details may be kept confidential with the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the corporation is not carrying on business of any kind within the Republic of the Marshall Islands and has derived no income from RMI sources during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This certification is the jurisdictional keystone of tax exemption. Conducting local meetings from which management decisions are habitually made, employing RMI-based staff, or owning RMI real property would defeat the declaration and void the exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature and printed name of the president, vice-president, director, or duly authorized attorney-in-fact, together with date of signature.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A single officer attestation satisfies the filing requirement; the underlying register of directors is maintained at the registered agent and is not filed publicly.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge: US$100 per annual report. Failure to file within three months after the due date triggers a notice of strike-off from the Registrar; continued default results in administrative dissolution, automatic loss of the non-resident tax exemption, and termination of the corporate shield.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Annual Declaration — Form ESF-1 (Economic Substance Regulations Act 2019, as amended; Competent Authority: Registrar of Corporations acting jointly with the RMI Banking Commissioner) filed electronically through the RMI e-Registry or through the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 12 months after the end of the relevant financial year. The default financial year is the calendar year unless an election to adopt a different accounting period has been accepted by the Registrar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, registration number, incorporation date, financial year-end, and registered agent reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete using the Certificate of Incorporation and the Non-Resident Certificate; the registered agent will typically pre-fill the portal fields.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part A, Box 2 — Relevant Activity Assessment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration indicating each of the nine statutory relevant activities engaged in during the accounting period: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property business, and distribution and service centre.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A private charitable foundation conducting endowment management and scientific grant-making (ISIC 6430 / NAICS 813211) is not a Collective Investment Vehicle regulated under the RMI Mutual Funds Act; therefore the 'fund management' category should not be selected. The correct declaration for a pure charitable endowment is 'No Relevant Activity conducted.'

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part A, Box 3 — Foreign Tax Residence Claim
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Where a relevant activity is declared, the entity may claim exclusion by proving tax residence in a jurisdiction outside the RMI, supported by a foreign tax identification number and a certificate of residence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a foundation declaring no relevant activity this box remains blank. If ever completed, the foreign certificate must be current and authentic; false residence claims are treated as an aggravating offence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part B, Box 4 — Core Income-Generating Activity and Substance Particulars
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: For each relevant activity declared: description of core income-generating activities performed in the RMI, number of employees in the RMI, physical premises in the RMI, and RMI operating expenditure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Leave nil where no relevant activity is declared. If the foundation later engages in asset-holding of investment securities, it should assess whether the 'holding company' category is triggered; if so, the reduced substance test (adequate employees and premises for holding and managing equity participations) must be satisfied or foreign residence proven.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signed declaration by a director, officer, or the authorized registered agent attesting that the information is true, correct, and complete.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Signing officers should verify all boxes personally; the declaration is a sworn attestation attracting criminal liability for false statements.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or omitted ESF-1 filings incur fines beginning at US$5,000 with continuing monthly penalties for persistent default, escalating to a statutory maximum of US$50,000; knowingly false or misleading declarations attract fines up to US$50,000 and/or imprisonment of responsible officers up to 5 years. The Registrar may also strike off the entity and is expressly authorized to exchange information with foreign tax authorities through the Global Forum and AEOI channels.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the Marshall Islands imposes no dividend withholding tax, no branch remittance tax, and no withholding tax of any kind under the Income Tax Act 1971 or any other statutory instrument. Dividends declared by the non-resident BC to foreign charitable beneficiaries or controlling donors are paid gross with no RMI tax deduction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable and administratively unavailable: the Republic of the Marshall Islands has concluded zero comprehensive double taxation agreements (nil DTA network) and has no TRC-based relief procedure. Because the RMI does not impose withholding tax, there is no domestic tax against which treaty relief could operate. The only corporate documents issuable by the Registry are the Certificate of Corporate Existence and Certificate of Good Standing / Non-Resident Certificate; these are routinely furnished to foreign paying agents and banking compliance teams as documentary evidence that RMI dividends are exempt from local tax and are not the subject of any residence-based RMI claim. No Marshallese approval protocol, form, or fee exists for treaty relief because no treaty partner exists.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% statutory rate — no RMI withholding tax on outbound or inbound intellectual-property royalties. Interest: 0% statutory rate — no RMI withholding tax on debenture interest, intercompany loans, or bank deposits. Treaty rates: none available, as the RMI has no tax treaty network. The RMI also maintains no exchange control legislation, so grant distributions, endowment investment returns, and capital remittances are freely transferable in US dollars. Recipients remain taxable according to their own residence regimes, and the RMI participates in CRS/AEOI and FATCA information exchange, which will report underlying financial account information regardless of the absence of withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — no local-currency filing threshold exists. The Marshall Islands has not enacted transfer pricing legislation and does not impose Local File, Master File, or Country-by-Country Reporting obligations on non-resident business corporations. The functional currency of the Republic is the US dollar (USD), and statutory fees are denominated exclusively in USD. Thin capitalization, interest limitation, and debt-equity rules are likewise absent from RMI law.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Comparable Uncontrolled Price (CUP) — not statutorily codified in RMI; recognized only as an OECD-aligned administrative concept
Resale Price Method — not statutorily codified; no RMI enforcement precedent exists
Cost Plus Method — not statutorily codified; no RMI enforcement precedent exists
Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM) — the OECD-aligned default concept; purely administrative guidance in the RMI
Profit Split Method — not statutorily codified; unavailable as a domestic filing requirement because no RMI transfer pricing regime exists
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The Economic Substance Regulations Act 2019, as amended, entered into force for financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2021 and requires every RMI-registered relevant entity to file an annual economic substance declaration (ESF-1). An entity engaged in any of the nine statutory relevant activities must demonstrate economic substance in the RMI — direction and management in the RMI, adequate employees, premises, and expenditure — or prove tax residence in a foreign jurisdiction. Critical classification: a private charitable foundation conducting endowment management and grant distribution (ISIC 6430 / NAICS 813211) is not a Collective Investment Vehicle under the RMI Mutual Funds Act and therefore does not conduct the statutory activity of 'fund management.' The correct ongoing posture is to file the ESF-1 each year declaring no relevant activity. The foundation must, however, diligently preserve its non-resident status: no RMI-source income, no habitual board meetings in the Republic, no locally employed staff, and no RMI real property. If asset-holding expands to active investment management of portfolio companies, the 'holding company' category may be triggered, in which case a reduced substance test applies and foreign tax residence must be documented.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Abuse of the Non-Resident Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the foundation as a de facto RMI-resident entity: holding effective board and investment committee meetings in Majuro, employing RMI-based administrative personnel, deriving rental or professional income from RMI sources, or conducting local grant-funded charitable operations while continuing to certify 'non-resident' status in the BCA Annual Report.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retroactive assessment of 3% corporate income tax on all RMI-source income under the Income Tax Act 1971, plus statutory monthly interest on unpaid tax and late-payment penalties reaching 100% of the tax due; fines of up to US$10,000 for false certification; administrative strike-off and loss of the non-resident tax exemption certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and signatories of the false annual report may be personally assessed for the unpaid corporate tax (civil recovery piercing the corporate veil), barred from holding future RMI registrations, and criminally prosecuted with fines of up to US$25,000 and/or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years per false certification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Economic Substance Offence / Shell Company Determination
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the annual ESF-1; declaring a relevant activity such as holding company while maintaining no RMI substance whatsoever; submitting a materially false declaration claiming foreign tax residence without any documentary back-up; or re-characterizing grant-making as fund management to obtain a regulatory license that the foundation does not hold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines beginning at US$5,000 for late filing, escalating through US$10,000 for defective returns and up to US$50,000 for sustained non-compliance; court-ordered strike-off and dissolution; referral of the entity to the Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information for Exchange of Information on Request (EOIR), potentially triggering foreign tax investigations in grantor-donor jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers knowingly causing the contravention are jointly and severally liable for corporate fines; criminal conviction carries imprisonment of up to 5 years; travel bans may be imposed pending cooperation with foreign tax information requests, and adverse regulatory findings will be shared across the AEOI network.
